title: LLaDA2.1: Speeding Up Text Diffusion via Token Editing
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical aspects of speeding up text diffusion for Large Language Models through a novel 'Draft-and-Edit' paradigm. Its evaluation is based on objective performance benchmarks such as MMLU-Pro, coding tasks, and mathematical reasoning. There is no component related to evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
